infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: LifeOS uses your location to track runs, cycling, surf sessions, and walks in real time.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: LifeOS requires background location to record your workout route when your phone is locked or you switch apps.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: LifeOS records your routes continuously during active workouts.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: LifeOS uses motion data to calculate moving time, elevation gain, and cadence.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow LifeOS to record your GPS activity routes in the background.
